info.title: ORBITAL physician mobile API — proposed contract
info.description: IMPLEMENTATION CONTRACT ONLY. These physician endpoints do not exist in inspected CRM code yet. Existing web /api/viewer and manager /mobile/api are different contracts. No real credentials in examples. See doctor-mobile-integration-v1-2026-11-08.md.

servers.description: Target production origin; routes pending backend implementation

get.description: PROPOSED endpoint; not deployed at time of contract preparation. No PHI or secrets. A web HTML response / 404 means mobile API is unavailable, never use a silent demo fallback.

post.summary: Create QR in physician web cabinet
post.description: PROPOSED endpoint; not deployed at time of contract preparation. Server selects the logged-in physician. No arbitrary doctorId. Ticket lives 120 seconds; body and QR must not be logged.

post.summary: Exchange one-time ticket for device session
post.description: PROPOSED endpoint; not deployed at time of contract preparation. Atomically one session per ticket. Same clientRequestId/device retry can replay short-lived protected response; different request/device gets pairing_used. Rate-limit.
PROPOSED endpoint; not deployed at time of contract preparation. Atomic rotation and reuse detection; same requestId retry is briefly idempotent. Absolute session lifetime is not extended by refresh.

delete.description: PROPOSED endpoint; not deployed at time of contract preparation. Cancel local downloads. Revocation affects future grants; offline access lasts at most until signed grant expiry without connectivity.

post.summary: Pin bundle and issue exact GET URLs
post.description: PROPOSED endpoint; not deployed at time of contract preparation. Validate explicit user ACL, feature/permission, current source/profile/generation, live publication and HOT expiry. Idempotent same requestId/payload after rechecking current access. 409 download_not_ready/source_changed; 404 hidden unauthorized object.

post.summary: Refresh URLs for at most 128 known file IDs
post.description: PROPOSED endpoint; not deployed at time of contract preparation. Recheck session, ACL, bundle ownership and source/generation. No caller bucket/key/URL. Same inventory; refreshed URLs may differ. source_changed stops incomplete old download; never merge versions.

post.summary: Renew signed access to known downloaded bundle
post.description: PROPOSED endpoint; not deployed at time of contract preparation. Bundle must be known from prior grant and remain authorized/renewable. Never trust arbitrary client hash as proof of ownership. 410 bundle_expired when not renewable.

crmWebSession.name: session
crmWebSession.description: Physician web only; use actual configured Flask session cookie name on deployment, not iOS auth

csrfHeader.name: X-CSRFToken
csrfHeader.description: Valid CRM CSRF token for QR creation

PairingQr.description: QR is untrusted input until HTTPS exchange with an explicitly trusted server. No permanent password.

Study.description: Lists are ACL-filtered. bundle/totalBytes/hotExpiresAt are present when a mobile publication is ready. canDownload requires permission, scope and current publication.

DownloadInventory.description: Immutable generation inventory, shared across authorized doctors. Hash exact UTF-8 bytes before parsing. No URLs, keys, original DICOM, mutable pointer or inventory self-entry. Enforce uniqueness, file membership and byte sum in addition to schema.

offlineGrant.description: JWS Compact ES256. Signature is raw 64-byte R||S; verify with a trusted key, never decode-only.

DownloadGrant.description: Grant pins exactly one immutable bundle. Resource membership must match inventory, exact HTTPS storage origins are allowlisted. CRM Bearer must never be sent to storage.

offlineGrant.description: JWS Compact ES256. Signature is raw 64-byte R||S; verify with a trusted key, never decode-only.

OfflineGrantClaims.description: Decoded payload for implementation and fixtures only; never trust unsigned JSON. Verify ES256, kid, time, bindings and inventory hash. Test key is forbidden in production.

LocalStudyDescriptor.description: Native-only private-library descriptor. Storage root is private; viewer gets only restricted local prefix/series, never authorization tokens. Descriptor is not itself authorization.

ApiError.description: JSON error, no HTML/redirect. 401 invalid session; 403 permission globally disabled; 404 absent or unauthorized object; 409 not-ready/source-changed; 410 expired; 429 rate limit; 503 temporary failure. No tokens or PHI in error text.

x-cache-policy: All PHI, auth, grants: Cache-Control no-store. Redact Authorization, QR ticket, refresh, signed URLs and offline grant from logs.
